editorial_thesis: Useful agent leverage is moving down a layer: portable skills, model routing economics, embedded evidence, and structured domain APIs make the seam explicit and reviewable.

topic_groups.title: Agent Skills + Interoperability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A portable skill format is moving from vendor feature to shared infrastructure; this is a high-leverage coverage gap after yesterday’s platform-convergence lane.

sources.title: Agent Skills donated to AAIF
sources.why_selected: Fresh, practical signal not covered in the prior day ledger.
sources.usefulness: Package recurring Buildn review, report, and publishing procedures as skills; store owner, version, permissions, and evidence requirements beside each skill.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.why_selected: Fresh, practical signal not covered in the prior day ledger.
sources.usefulness: Use it as the interchange format for client playbooks, QA checklists, and report-generation procedures.

sources.title: Agentskills GitHub organization
sources.why_selected: Fresh, practical signal not covered in the prior day ledger.

sources.title: MCP remains the neighboring seam

sources.title: Security guidance is now on the roadmap

topic_groups.title: Embedded Assessments + AI Governance
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Independent evaluation is an under-covered governance lane with direct relevance to Buildn’s evidence-first operating model.
